verdict.rationale: The story asks whether Customer.io lets a user plug external MCP servers into it so its AI can use their tools (Customer.io acting as an MCP client). The evidence only shows the reverse: Customer.io ships its own official MCP server (customer-io-probe-3, customer-io-docs-9/10/16) for other agents to connect to and call its tools, which is a different capability. No evidence shows Customer.io's AI assistant/CLI/Slack integration can consume arbitrary external MCP servers.
